page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance in the Enhanced instance family. Powered by KVM hypervisor technology, it features 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The server does not include local storage, relying on network-attached block storage for system volumes and data persistence. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 23 Gbps. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation maximizes vCPU density while avoiding excess memory costs for compute-heavy workloads.

This server profile is structured for CPU-bound tasks that do not require high memory-per-core ratios or local NVMe storage. Best-fit use cases include continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) workers, batch processing workloads, microservices architectures, web server clusters, and ETL execution pipelines.
